texts.title: Seasonal Rainfall Outlook – CAR
texts.subtitle: Outlook: October 2026 – March 2027 (as of September 30, 2026)
texts.notes: 1 mm of rainfall is equivalent to 1 liter of rain falling on 1 m² of land. Over one hectare, this corresponds to 10,000 liters of rainfall.
texts.disclaimer: DA RFO CAR is not liable to any loss or damages arising from utilizing the Farm Weather Outlook and Advisory. The forecast is valid only to the dates and municipality stated.
texts.sources: DOST-PAGASA seasonal climate outlook; processed by DA-RFO-CAR AMIA
texts.recommendations:
Agricultural advisory for the season October 2026 – March 2027:
- Months with < 50 mm in many municipalities: February 2027 and March 2027. Plan planting so critical crop stages avoid these months; use early-maturing and drought-tolerant varieties.
- Below-normal seasonal rainfall in Itogon, Tuba, Tublay, La Trinidad, Sablan, Bokod, Asipulo, Kiangan, Buguias, Kibungan, Hingyon and Mankayan and 15 other areas: store water (small farm reservoirs, SWIP/SSIP), repair irrigation canals and promote water-saving technologies.
- Above-normal rainfall in Pudtol, Santa Marcela, Calanasan and Luna: improve drainage, guard against soil erosion and plan harvests around the wettest months.
- Lowest season totals: Tuba, Sablan, La Trinidad, Baguio City, Itogon, Kapangan, Tublay and Kibungan and 9 other areas. Prioritise these areas for water management interventions and crop insurance (PCIC) enrolment.
- 1 mm of rain = 1 litre per m² (10 m³ per hectare): compare with crop water requirements when planning irrigation.
texts.issuing_office: Department of Agriculture – Regional Field Office, Cordillera Administrative Region (AMIA Program)
texts.advice_rice: Time planting so flowering avoids the driest months; dry months: March. Use early-maturing varieties and store water for the dry part of the season. Expect heavy rain in October.
texts.advice_corn: Plant at the start of the wetter months and use drought-tolerant or early-maturing hybrids. Mulch and keep drainage open in the wettest months.
texts.advice_hvc: Plan staggered planting with irrigation (SWIP/SSIP, drip). Use rain shelters in wet months and mulch in dry months; prioritise high-value crops under irrigation.
